verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a self-hosted deployment option via Docker Compose or Kubernetes, supporting AWS/GCP/Azure/air-gapped environments and custom/self-hosted LLMs, with logs stored only on customer servers. This is first-party documentation only, without independent/hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment. Missing for 10: independent verification that self-hosting actually works end-to-end, and clarity on whether 'core product' (all review/agent features) is fully feature-complete in self-hosted mode.
